title: Pfizer Paid Billions for Obesity Assets. Is It Already Cutting Its Losses?
summary: Pfizer, Roche and Amgen are pruning obesity programs that lack clear differentiation. The GLP-1 market has moved from a race to enter the clinic to a contest across efficacy, safety, convenience and commercial execution.
cover_image_alt: Pfizer, Roche and Amgen prune obesity candidates as the GLP-1 market enters a higher-bar shakeout
card_image_alt: Big Pharma obesity-pipeline cuts show the GLP-1 market entering a tougher second half
homepage_cover_image_alt: The obesity drug shakeout accelerates as ordinary GLP-1 programs lose their ticket to compete
